notes.title: Update 4.0 Details
notes.content:
Update Details:
-Setting to display side bars for short combat range
-Settings to display command lists on side bards
-Recording and playback feature for training mode. 
-Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 3.0 Live Now !
notes.content:
UPDATE 3.0 includes following features:
-Match recording
-Assist mode for beginners
-New character colors
-Button assignment for Boost Dive
-New options for training mode
     -Reset parts and positions
     -Enemy ground recovery settings
     -Enemy dodge settings

New character colors can be selected with L2 button during you select your character.

notes.title: Update 2.0 Now Live !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42751161/bd56b356f4cf34e9b11ea547db72ece45b56c2b2.jpg[/img]

Patch 2.0 additional features and updates :
- Online/Offline Rematch
- Spectator mode (lobby)
- Combat Range: wide/short
- New settings in training mode:
　・CPU strength settings.
　・Recovery timing of CPU.
- Match time setting  99 added.
In addition to the above, several game balance adjustment

More to come soon!
